Name: (CP and AT) Elegant Cats

Description:

﻿

[/i][i][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]﻿﻿﻿Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional but highly recommended for
﻿﻿﻿the content patcher version of the mod as it is easier to make changes.[/size][/i]
﻿[size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]﻿﻿What does this mod do?[/size]
[/b][size=2]﻿This mod changes textures of[b] all 3 vanilla cats[/b]. ﻿
You can choose between [b]9 colors[/b] for each cat option. (see images)
[/size]
[b][size=6][color=#ff7700] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/QIS48Vc.png[/img][/color][/size]

[/b][b][size=5][color=#ffff00] ﻿﻿﻿﻿[CP Version][/color][/size][/b][b][size=5]
[/size][/b][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]﻿1.[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]Make sure you have the latest version of [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#999999][size=2][i]﻿∗﻿﻿[Optionally you can install [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url][/size][/color][i][color=#999999][size=2]]
[/size][/color]
[/i][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]﻿﻿2. [/b][/size][/color][b][size=3]Extract the zip file into your stardew valley mod folder[/size][/b][size=3].[/size]
[size=2]﻿﻿(default path if you play on steam: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/size]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]﻿﻿ ﻿[AT Version]
[/size][/color]
﻿﻿[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]1.[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]Make sure you have the latest version of [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description]Alternative Textures[/url][/u][u] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[/u][/b][/size][i]
[/i][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]﻿﻿2.[color=#999999] [/color][/b][/size][/color][b][size=3]Extract the zip file into your stardew valley mod folder[/size][/b][size=3].[/size]
[color=#999999][size=2]﻿﻿(default path if you play on steam: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/size][/color][/b]

[b][size=4] ﻿﻿﻿﻿[Optional][/size][/b]
﻿
﻿﻿﻿﻿Optionally you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] version of this mod instead of the content patcher or alternative textures one.
﻿﻿﻿Simply extract the files into your Adopt 'n' Skin folder!
﻿﻿﻿You might want to rename the files if you already have other cat skins installed.
﻿﻿﻿For more information visit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] page.
﻿



[b][size=5] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/mhjTouj.png[/img][/size][/b][color=#ff7700]

[/color][b][size=5][color=#ffff00] ﻿﻿﻿﻿[CP Version]
[/color][/size][/b][size=3]﻿﻿You can either install [i]mod config[/i] menu or change the values in [i]content.json[/i] file.
﻿
﻿[b]replace cat[/b]- if true, the mod is on. If false the mod is disabled.
[b]﻿﻿﻿replace icon[/b]- if true, changes the cat icon in menu. If false, the icon stays vanilla.
﻿
﻿﻿﻿There are 3 cat variants you can choose from in vanilla game (you choose them while creating your character).
﻿This mod allows you to change their textures independently. So far the mod offers 9 different color options.
﻿The names represent colors of the fur (see image above): 
[b]﻿ashy, rosy, onyx, creamy, smokey, graphite, ginger, brownie, snowy[/b]

[b]﻿﻿﻿mod config menu [/b]lets you change all the values while in game.[/size]

[size=5] ﻿﻿﻿﻿[/size][b][color=#ffff00][size=5]﻿[AT Version]
[/size]
[/color][/b][size=3]To change the appearance of your cat you need [b]scissors[/b] tool purchased from [b]Robin's shop[/b].

[b]﻿﻿﻿Click on the cat while holding the scissors[/b] and choose an option from the pop-up menu.[/size]
